text: rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate . atha kho pañcasikho gandhabbaputto 1 yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi . ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho pañcasikho gandhabbaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme no parinibbāyanti . ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭhe va dhamme parinibbāyantīti 2 . [181] santi ca 3 kho pañcasikha cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā .pe. santi kho pañcasikha manoviññeyyā
